source.title: Disney Concert Hall 3D Model

source.changes: Graph transforms baked; uniform scale/rotation/translation registered to cached2023LiDAR and2022NAIP; site/seating omitted; triangle surfaces voxelized at1m without downward fill; outer roof slab material adapted to known stainless-steel exterior.

nativeFrame: Original Rhino Z-up coordinates recovered by applying nativeFromScene after glTF graph transform.

registration.method: Uniform physical transform fitted to2m triangle-surface envelope, high-sail roadside locations and cached OSM/NAIP; positive full3D determinant required.
limitations: Academic reconstruction, not surveyed as-built geometry.
Front low sail protrudes beyond exact mapped footprint before runtime guard; report clipped cell counts.
Peripheral site walls omitted; preserve original unmodeled podiums and planted terraces.
registration.reviewDecision: Use positive determinant78.05degree candidate; rigid authored model fit accepted as an illustrative shell reconstruction, not surveyed geometry.

runtimeGuards.clearRegion: Convex hull of accepted model plan cells plus2m, intersect exactfootprint and excludegardens/neighbours
